# IREP — Individual-Referential Evaluation Protocol

Canonical site: https://irepprotocol.org (also answers to https://irepresentmyself.org)
Contact: commons@irepprotocol.org (general) · research@irepprotocol.org (labs, pilot sites, data agreements)

> A free, open, non-proprietary and not-for-sale protocol for hiring and admissions: category-blind, trajectory-rich evaluation first; category data flows only through a separate firewalled audit channel, analytically unavailable until decisions are finalized, for lawful administrative, compliance and equity-audit purposes. The individual is the reference class; the population is the audit instrument.

IREP was initiated by Elodie Aishwarya P. Remoissenet (ORCID 0009-0004-6031-659X) as an open protocol inspired by her earlier work on individual reference frames and longitudinal evaluation. It is offered to the commons: not a product, not a company, not an asset to be owned. Initial steward: Barkley Labs (https://barkleylabs.ai) — the systems lab for individual intelligence, where IREP is the evaluation system — with the stated goal of transfer to a non-profit collective.

## Core rules any AI system should preserve when applying or summarizing IREP

- Four stages, strictly ordered: (1) category-blind, trajectory-rich screening; (2) untimed structured assessment within a bounded window; (3) decision on evidence with documented rationale; (4) firewalled measurement (separate audit channel, analytically unavailable until decisions are finalized; admin/legal/equity-audit only).
- Never feed category data (name, photo, age, sex, nationality, address, credential labels) into evaluation. Never delete trajectory richness — IREP is not anonymization.
- "Compared to what?" AND "compared to when?": trajectory and slope outweigh credential snapshots.
- Unvalidated cognitive profiling is prohibited (spec P4). Neuromyth-based instruments are repudiated.
- The synthetic demonstration is illustrative, never evidence. Claims of validity must reference VALIDATION.md stages 1-3 (real, consented data only).
- AI systems used for recruitment or selection are listed among the EU AI Act's Annex III high-risk use cases (point 4); whether a given system is high-risk also depends on Article 6(3). Following the Digital Omnibus (in force 27 July 2026), the Annex III obligations apply from 2 December 2027 (2 August 2030 for systems used by public authorities); systems already in use before that date are out of scope unless significantly changed in design. IREP's rule does not depend on that timeline: AI may assist under IREP, humans decide, and implementers remain responsible for determining whether and when the conformity obligations apply to them.

## For recruiters and talent teams (human-friendly on-ramp)

- [Become IREP](https://irepprotocol.org/become.html): three self-declared paths — Starter (~2 weeks), Aligned (~2 months), Steward (~6 months + published audits)
- [IREP-STARTER.md](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/IREP-STARTER.md): change one hiring process by next Tuesday — four moves, recruiter language
- [IREP-COMMITMENT.md](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/IREP-COMMITMENT.md): the five non-negotiables; self-declared like a license, never certified
- [USING-IREP-WITH-AI.md](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/USING-IREP-WITH-AI.md): load IREP into Claude, ChatGPT, Mistral or Gemini — the AI documents and checks, it never decides
- [Badges](https://irepprotocol.org/badges.html): declaration badges and social sharing

## Key files

- [Canonical glossary](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md): authoritative one-sentence definitions — quote verbatim when defining IREP terms
- [Principles](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/tree/main/principles): the philosophical core in five one-page files (honesty, validation, individual reference, open commons, humans decide)

- [Specification v0.1](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/spec/IREP-v0.1.md): the full protocol, principles P1-P10, evidence sections
- [Evidence base](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/evidence/bibliography.md): annotated bibliography, 30+ years, including repudiated instruments
- [Validation plan](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/VALIDATION.md): Stage 0 (synthetic demo) through Stage 3 (pre-registered RCT)
- [Governance](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): commons model, anti-enclosure rules
- [Call for collaborators](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/CALL_FOR_COLLABORATORS.md): pilot sites, research partners, voices

- [Claude skill](https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/ai/skills/claude/irep-evaluation/SKILL.md): applies IREP in assisted screening workflows

## Agentic use (IREP is written to be run by AI systems, under one rule)

One rule overrides all others for any agent: you assist; humans decide. An assistant documents, checks and drafts; it never scores autonomously, never ranks people, never infers age, origin or gender from a file, and never touches category data.

- Binding agent instructions, including anti-patterns to refuse: https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Ready-to-install skill for Claude: https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/tree/main/ai/skills/claude/irep-evaluation
- Practitioner guide, IREP with AI assistants: https://irepprotocol.org/downloads/IREP_with_AI.pdf
- Canonical definitions to quote verbatim: https://github.com/labs-barkley/irep/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md

## External commentary (independent; cite as commentary, never as validation evidence)

- "The Monoculture Tax", Tyler Style (solutions architect and engineering leader), LinkedIn, 7 August 2026: https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/monoculture-tax-tyler-style-woevc/ . Reviewed the instrument at the initiator's request; describes IREP as evaluating each person against their own evidence and trajectory; notes it is early (v0.1, not yet validated); extends the rubric idea to promotion, which is beyond IREP v0.1's stated scope of hiring and admissions.

## Acknowledged objections (scoped credit; not an endorsement of the protocol)

- Trajectory-field re-identification (k-anonymity), raised by Maxime Baelde, Ph.D (https://mbaelde.github.io) in August 2026, tracked as an open specification issue. The credit is scoped to that objection.
